summary: Route Mode slice 5. New budget operation learning_path_plan (approved by the owner on 2026-10-05): the research goal and draft keywords go to the model through the single gateway and come back as a concept graph, which is repaired locally (normalize), checked against OpenAlex concept by concept (route_ground, only search terms are sent) and confirmed by the user in a layered editor on the creation page; create_project and finalize_guidance carry the confirmed map and the concepts the user already knows. Each creation session allows 1 + 2 paid attempts, reserved before the call and counted whenever the provider was reached. Includes prompts/learning-path-plan.md, the registry entry, the editor and 12 node tests.
scope_note: Branch feature/route-mode, on top of fcb14b8. New prompt and budget operation (critical). The owner approved the operation in the session; the agent did not set approval itself. The owner's .claude files are excluded locally.

budget_impact.rationale: One new explicit operation, only on a click inside project creation: reference 900 input / 700 output tokens, cap 1200 / 900, 1 + 2 paid attempts per creation session at most, under the existing daily/monthly ceilings and the AI master switch. Everything else in this slice (repair, grounding against OpenAlex, editing, progress) is zero model tokens. Token figures are registry reference/cap values, not measurements.

quantified.period: per generation (registry reference; cap in the registry is 1200 in / 900 out = $0.001440)

budget_impact.before: No operation produced a learning path; the saved path was free text, never read.
budget_impact.after: learning_path_plan, approved, bounded, ledgered; at most three paid attempts per creation session.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.scope: PaperDigHelper.app rebuilt; window not clicked through

reviews.reviewer: One separate read-only code-review agent (same model family, not a human); findings fixed afterwards, fixes not re-read by a reviewer.

open_risks: No real DeepSeek call was made by the agent: whether a real reply follows the requested JSON structure and how many concepts and tokens it uses is unmeasured; the 900-token output cap could truncate a long reply (it would then be a counted bad reply).
The instruction-size claim is a pessimistic heuristic (1.5 tokens per Chinese character), not a tokenizer measurement.
Concept search terms are sent to OpenAlex when the user clicks the literature check; this extends the public-metadata disclosure of ADR 0012.
The independent review was by an agent of the same model family; its findings were fixed and the fixes were not re-read by a reviewer.
The editor cannot set a concept's difficulty hint (new concepts default to 2); the 20 s grounding deadline and per-concept eight-paper sample are proposals.
If Organization.action fails after the project row exists (a disk failure), the project is left without its map.
Slices 6 (runtime use of the map in batches, profile and Today page, knowledge-base layer), 7 (growth UI) and 8 (R-ROUTE/ROUTE-01/E-ROUTE, ADR 0013, PRODUCT/ARCHITECTURE) are not done.
